## SChat Changelog:
*No internal App Changes*

## Discord Changelog:
### Supported Changes:
- We now offer WebM content support. This has been a bit of a platform parity gap, but iOS users like yourself can now view WebM video assets!
- Fixed a bug where the Emoji Picker buttons to scroll to particular sections weren't navigating properly. […]
- Resolved a bug that caused emojis in usernames to be cut off in the DM list. […]

### Unsupported Changes:
- You'll now see custom emojis in your message notifications! […]
